specs.label: Focus

paragraphs: I am an undergraduate mechanical engineering student at IIITDM Kurnool with hands-on experience in CAD/CAE, structural FEA, electromechanical prototyping, and system-level vehicle design.
My work spans IIT Roorkee research, BAJA SAE suspension engineering, and multi-disciplinary fabrication projects, each with measured results.

points: Designed and fabricated an assistive page-reading device for visually impaired users, integrating mechanical actuation with embedded control.
Engineered a custom Braille display cam-actuation mechanism in SolidWorks for repeatable haptic output and compact packaging.
Developed a Python-based GUI supporting digital document upload, automated text parsing, and real-time serial communication with hardware.
Programmed an Arduino microcontroller to drive stepper motors, synchronizing rotational cam movements with incoming digital text streams.

projects.title: Suspension, BAJA SAE
projects.summary: Off-road suspension designed for fatigue resistance under harsh terrain loads.
details: Defined suspension geometry and hardpoints, validating structural integrity with FEA and multi-body dynamics simulations.
Optimized load paths to reduce unsprung mass by 12% while preserving 100% structural reliability.

projects.title: Go-Kart Design & Fabrication
projects.summary: End-to-end design and fabrication of a student go-kart: chassis, drivetrain, braking.
details: Applied material selection and DFM/DFA across procurement, jigging, and workshop assembly.
Reduced build cost by 10% while meeting structural and dynamic targets.

projects.title: Ambient Node, Kinetic LED Lamp
projects.summary: Modular electromechanical lamp emphasizing repeatability, thermal clearance, and serviceability.
details: Parametric 3D CAD assemblies with articulated joints and protective enclosures for sensors and power electronics.
Modular architecture reduced assembly time by 15%.

projects.title: All-Terrain Rover CAD & Structural Analysis
projects.summary: Weight-optimized rover assembly focused on stiffness-to-weight ratio.
details: Static stress and load simulations in ANSYS under peak operational loads.
Validated safety factors and documentation, improving structural efficiency by about 8%.

image.alt: All-terrain rover CAD & FEA structural stress analysis

projects.title: Strain Analysis of Heterogeneous Structures
projects.summary: Stress-strain response of heterogeneous material architectures under varying loads.
details: Wrote MATLAB algorithms to evaluate strain distribution and deformation fields.
Improved predictive accuracy of deformation, giving a data-driven basis for structural validation and failure prevention.
